title: Allow re-positioning items in the grid in widget mode (currently this feature is implemented only in the containment representation i.e. on the desktop)
line: Icons in a Folder View widget can now be dragged anywhere in its grid and stay where you put them, like on the desktop.
explanation: The Folder View widget forced its view to be locked whenever it wasn't the desktop itself, and only enabled the positioner (the model that keeps manual icon positions) for the desktop containment. So an icon dragged inside a widget always snapped back to its sorted slot, and since bug 513880 the widget settings didn't even offer Manual sorting. The change enables the positioner for the widget's own grid (not for subfolder preview popups or the panel list view), stops force-locking widgets so the existing "Lock in place" option decides, and offers Manual in the widget's Sort by list again.

commits.message:
containments/desktop: Allow arranging icons in Folder View widgets

Folder View widgets were always locked and never used the positioner,
so dragged icons snapped back to their sorted place. Use it for the
widget's own grid too, honour "Lock in place" and offer Manual sorting.

BUG: 365010

patches.diff:
From c7b679064a1741c50ca94dca976aa5e3dfd26410 Mon Sep 17 00:00:00 2001
From: =?UTF-8?q?Niccol=C3=B2=20Venerandi?= <niccolo@venerandi.com>
Date: Thu, 26 Nov 2026 23:03:42 +0100
Subject: [PATCH] containments/desktop: Allow arranging icons in Folder View
 widgets

Folder View widgets were always locked and never used the positioner,
so dragged icons snapped back to their sorted place. Use it for the
widget's own grid too, honour "Lock in place" and offer Manual sorting.

BUG: 365010
---
 .../package/contents/ui/ConfigIcons.qml       | 21 +++++++------------
 .../package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml        |  2 +-
 .../package/contents/ui/FolderViewLayer.qml   |  2 +-
 3 files changed, 9 insertions(+), 16 deletions(-)

diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ConfigIcons.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ConfigIcons.qml
index 24c55a915c..624efc1bdd 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ConfigIcons.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/ConfigIcons.qml
@@ -179,32 +179,25 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
             Kirigami.FormData.label: i18nc("@label:listbox sort items by field", "Sort by:")
 
             property int mode
-            // Manual arrangement is only supported on the desktop itself, not in Folder View widgets
-            readonly property bool manualAvailable: Plasmoid.isContainment
             // FIXME TODO HACK: This maps the combo box list model to the KDirModel::ModelColumns
             // enum, which should be done in C++.
-            readonly property var indexToMode: manualAvailable ? [-1, 0, 1, 6, 2] : [0, 1, 6, 2]
-            readonly property bool manual: indexToMode[currentIndex] === -1
+            property var indexToMode: [-1, 0, 1, 6, 2]
+            property var modeToIndex: {'-1': '0', '0': '1', '1': '2', '6': '3', '2': '4'}
 
-            model: (manualAvailable ? [i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort icons manually", "Manual")] : []).concat([
+            model: [i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort icons manually", "Manual"),
                     i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort icons by name", "Name"),
                     i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort icons by size", "Size"),
                     i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort icons by file type", "Type"),
-                    i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort icons by date", "Date")])
+                    i18nc("@item:inlistbox sort icons by date", "Date")]
 
-            Component.onCompleted: {
-                if (!manualAvailable && mode === -1) {
-                    mode = 0;
-                }
-                currentIndex = indexToMode.indexOf(mode);
-            }
+            Component.onCompleted: currentIndex = modeToIndex[mode]
             onActivated: index => mode = indexToMode[index]
         }
 
         CheckBox {
             id: sortDesc
 
-            enabled: !sortMode.manual
+            enabled: sortMode.currentIndex !== 0
 
             text: i18nc("@option:check sort icons in descending order", "Descending")
         }
@@ -212,7 +205,7 @@ KCM.SimpleKCM {
         CheckBox {
             id: sortDirsFirst
 
-            enabled: !sortMode.manual
+            enabled: sortMode.currentIndex !== 0
 
             text: i18nc("@option:check sort icons with folders first", "Folders first")
         }
diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
index b858d16f7a..c7c20c5dce 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderView.qml
@@ -1337,7 +1337,7 @@ FocusScope {
         Folder.Positioner {
             id: positioner
 
-            enabled: main.isRootView && main.sortMode === -1
+            enabled: (main.isRootView || (!main.dialog && !root.useListViewMode)) && main.sortMode === -1
 
             folderModel: dir
 
diff --git a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewLayer.qml b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewLayer.qml
index 02c7491b36..fa665c8293 100644
--- a/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewLayer.qml
+++ b/containments/desktop/package/contents/ui/FolderViewLayer.qml
@@ -214,7 +214,7 @@ FocusScope {
         positionerApplet: Plasmoid
 
         url: Plasmoid.configuration.url
-        locked: (Plasmoid.configuration.locked || !Plasmoid.isContainment || folderViewLayerComponent.lockedByKiosk)
+        locked: (Plasmoid.configuration.locked || folderViewLayerComponent.lockedByKiosk)
         filterMode: Plasmoid.configuration.filterMode
         filterPattern: Plasmoid.configuration.filterPattern
         filterMimeTypes: Plasmoid.configuration.filterMimeTypes
--
